clue.text: Fighters of film cover wall-painting with canvas, both short of length

indicators.note: both the painting word and the canvas word lose their L, the abbreviation for length
the canvas word is wrapped round the wall-painting word, covering it

parts.note: a sail is made of canvas, so canvas stands for sail
a mural is a painting on a wall

explanation.surface: An instruction for hanging canvas over a damaged wall-painting, with both pieces cut a bit too short.
explanation.walkthrough: 'both short of length' takes one L from each piece once they are combined. The film is Kurosawa's Seven Samurai, fitting the theme of sevens.
explanation.definitionFit: Kurosawa's film Seven Samurai is about hired swordsmen, Japanese warrior fighters, so they are fighters of film.

clue.text: Help to patrol rising sea which swimmers may be in

indicators.note: to patrol is to go round an area, so the help word surrounds the other piece

parts.note: SOS is the distress call for help

indicators.note: in a down clue rising means the sea word is read upwards, backwards

parts.note: the deep is the sea

explanation.surface: A lifeguard sent to patrol the rising tide where people are swimming.
explanation.definitionFit: This brand of swimwear is so familiar that its name stands for tight swimming trunks.

clue.text: Publication covering John Hurt's bit of four-person play?

indicators.note: the publication word covers, wrapping round, the rearranged letters

parts.note: a mag is a magazine, a publication

indicators.note: hurt means injured, so the letters of John are damaged into a new order

explanation.surface: A magazine covering the actor John Hurt's small role in a four-hander play.
explanation.walkthrough: 'John Hurt' looks like the actor, but Hurt is the anagram signal. The winner of this four-player tile game calls out its name, so the call is a bit of the play.
explanation.definitionFit: The Chinese tile game for four players has its winning call share its name, so it is one moment of play.

clue.text: Blunt, perhaps supporting Gunners, and rough

indicators.note: in a down clue the supporting word sits below, so it comes after

parts.note: RA is the Royal Artillery, the gunners
Anthony Blunt was a Soviet spy in Britain

explanation.surface: A blunt player, perhaps, backing Arsenal (the Gunners), and playing rough.
explanation.walkthrough: Anthony Blunt was the art historian exposed as a Soviet agent; 'Gunners' is also Arsenal football club's nickname.
explanation.definitionFit: A rough, grating voice is described as harsh and rasping.

clue.text: Set on answer held by one setting off

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

indicators.note: the answer letter is held inside the rearranged letters
off means the word setting is mixed up

explanation.surface: A puzzle's answer held by one setter as he sets off.
explanation.definitionFit: To set someone on is to incite or provoke them into action, which is to stir up.

clue.text: Tiresome people accepting Arabic support for Lawrence's wisdom

indicators.note: the word for tiresome people takes in the other piece, accepting it inside

parts.note: a pill is informal for a boring or tiresome person

explanation.surface: Bores who welcome Arabic support for the wisdom of Lawrence of Arabia.
explanation.walkthrough: T. E. Lawrence wrote 'Seven Pillars of Wisdom'; the clue fits the puzzle's theme of sevens.
explanation.definitionFit: Lawrence's book title says the house of wisdom stands on seven columns, so these are what support his wisdom.

clue.text: Landlord's place represents part of hip area

parts.note: a pub is run by a landlord
is can mean represents, as in this mark is a warning

explanation.surface: A landlord's premises standing for a trendy part of town.
explanation.definitionFit: This bone forms the front of the pelvis, part of the hip region.

clue.text: Endures

parts.note: split into end plus ures, the word offers a fitting picture of the final unbearable addition

explanation.walkthrough: The one word is read as what ends someone's endurance: the final burden that cannot be borne.
explanation.definitionFit: The proverbial final straw breaks the camel's back, ending what could be endured.

clue.text: Friar entering a place for baptism and incense, perhaps

indicators.note: the friar abbreviation goes into the font word

parts.note: a font holds the water for baptism
FR is short for friar

explanation.surface: A friar goes to a font for baptism, with incense burning.
explanation.walkthrough: 'incense' is the verb, to anger, not the fragrance burnt in church.
explanation.definitionFit: To incense someone is one way to insult or offend them deeply.

clue.text: No answer in physical exercising like a graceful spirit?

indicators.note: exercising puts the remaining letters through their paces into a new order
no answer means the answer letter is removed from physical

explanation.surface: Physical exercise with no answer makes one graceful as a spirit.
explanation.definitionFit: A sylph is an airy elemental or slender graceful girl; the adjective means resembling one.

clue.text: Revelations listed this church with humans behind mutilation of sheep

indicators.note: the humans word comes behind, after the rearranged letters
mutilation mangles the word sheep, so its letters are rearranged

parts.note: us means we humans, ourselves

explanation.surface: A grim note that the Book of Revelation listed a church, with people blamed for mutilating sheep.
explanation.walkthrough: The Book of Revelation addresses seven churches of Asia, the first of them at this city.
explanation.definitionFit: The Book of Revelation names seven churches in Asia Minor, beginning with the one at this ancient city.

clue.text: Party briefly satisfied mine worker

parts.note: a bash is an informal party

indicators.note: briefly means the word is cut short by its last letter

parts.note: full means satisfied after eating

explanation.surface: A miner content after a brief party.
explanation.definitionFit: In Snow White the seven dwarfs work in a mine, and this shy one is among them, so a mine worker.

clue.text: Detective (American) nabs terribly noisy sleeper at 9

indicators.note: the detective and American pieces seize the rearranged letters, holding them inside

parts.note: DI is a Detective Inspector

indicators.note: terribly signals the word noisy is jumbled

explanation.surface: A detective, an American, catches a terribly noisy man asleep at a place numbered 9.
explanation.walkthrough: 'at 9' points to the answer to 9 Across, the city where the legend sets the Seven Sleepers.
explanation.definitionFit: This was one of the Seven Sleepers of Ephesus, Christian youths said to have slept for centuries in a cave there.

clue.text: Saint's unwilling to go after sin

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for saint
loth means reluctant, as in loth to go

explanation.surface: A saint reluctant to follow after sinning.
explanation.definitionFit: Laziness is one of the seven deadly sins, so this word names a sin.

clue.text: Progression that starts with mewling, alienating even wise Greeks

indicators.note: alienating means driving the word even out of the longer phrase

parts.note: in As You Like It the seven ages of man begin with the infant mewling and puking

explanation.surface: Even wise Greeks are put off by a progression that starts with crying.
explanation.walkthrough: Shakespeare's speech lists the seven ages of man, the first being the mewling infant; take EVEN out of SEVEN AGES.
explanation.definitionFit: Ancient Greece honoured Seven Sages, philosophers and statesmen celebrated for their wisdom.

clue.text: Finally bury duck over in reserve plot

indicators.note: the last letter and the reversed duck go in the reserve word

parts.note: a store is a reserve or stock

indicators.note: finally takes the closing letter of bury
over means the duck word is turned round

parts.note: a duck in cricket is a score of nil

explanation.surface: Burying a duck, its life over, in a nature reserve.
explanation.walkthrough: A duck is a batsman's score of zero in cricket.
explanation.definitionFit: A plot is the sequence of events of a narrative, its line of story.

clue.text: Sea salt caught in caper

indicators.note: the salt and caught pieces go in the word for caper

parts.note: an antic is a playful caper
a tar or salt is an old sailor
C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

explanation.surface: A sea dog caught up in some escapade on the water.
explanation.walkthrough: 'salt' looks like seawater, but it is a sailor.
explanation.definitionFit: The southern ocean round the polar continent is counted among the seven seas.

clue.text: In experiment, I married a priest at the best moment

indicators.note: the pieces go in the experiment word

parts.note: a test is an experiment
Eli was the priest in the Bible who raised Samuel

explanation.definitionFit: Most well-timed means arriving most opportunely, at the ideal moment.

clue.text: It's a wonder mother collects gold only

indicators.note: the mother word gathers the other pieces inside itself

parts.note: mum is mother
AU is the chemical symbol for gold
sole means only

explanation.surface: Amazement that mother collects gold and nothing else.
explanation.definitionFit: The tomb at Halicarnassus was one of the Seven Wonders of the ancient world.

clue.text: Channels head off banality in manuscript

indicators.note: the shortened banality word goes in the manuscript abbreviation
head off means the first letter is removed

parts.note: tedium is dull banality

explanation.surface: A manuscript where banality channels the writer's thoughts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Channels' is a noun, people who carry messages from spirits, not the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: Psychics who pass on spirit messages are called channels, as the dead supposedly speak through them.

clue.text: Lacking initiative, more than one doctor maintains new power clears cases

indicators.note: maintains means holds, so the doctors word keeps the other pieces inside
lacking its initial letter, the doctors word loses its first letter

parts.note: quacks is slang for doctors
P is the physics symbol for power

explanation.surface: Several unenterprising doctors keep new power for clearing their cases.
explanation.definitionFit: Emptying suitcases after a trip is clearing them of their contents.

clue.text: Twisted band emitting energy that's evil like 12

indicators.note: emitting means giving off, so the energy letter leaves the band word

parts.note: a wreath is a band of twisted flowers or leaves
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: A twisted gang giving off evil energy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'like 12' refers to SLOTH at 12 Across: this is another deadly sin.
explanation.definitionFit: Anger is, like sloth, among the seven deadly sins, so it is an evil of the same kind.

clue.text: Summoned, did something about Channel Islands

indicators.note: the did something word goes about, round, the island abbreviation

parts.note: acted means did something, took action

explanation.surface: Called up, someone acted on the Channel Islands.
explanation.definitionFit: This archaic legal verb means called before a court, so it means cited or called.

clue.text: Old cradle song has variant for husband's heart

indicators.note: the variant letters go in place of the middle of the husband word

parts.note: hubby is informal for husband

explanation.surface: An old lullaby has a different version for the husband's heart.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heart' marks the middle letter B of HUBBY as the one swapped out for SHA, the reordered letters of has.

clue.text: Take sports class initiation for young housemate of 10

parts.note: to do someone is to take or cheat them
PE is physical education, a school sports class

indicators.note: an initiation is a start, so only the first letter of young is used

explanation.surface: Signing up for a sports class as an initiation for young people.
explanation.walkthrough: '10' refers to BASHFUL at 10 Across; Snow White's seven dwarfs share a cottage.
explanation.definitionFit: The dozy dwarf lives in the same cottage as his shy companion, making him a housemate.

clue.text: Holding Gotham back, protects one against Thebes

parts.note: Gotham is a nickname for New York, NY

explanation.surface: Batman's city, holding out, protects someone against a city in Greece.
explanation.walkthrough: In Aeschylus' Seven Against Thebes, this son of Oedipus leads the attack on his own city.
explanation.definitionFit: He was one of the Seven Against Thebes, the champions who attacked the city in Greek legend.

clue.text: Tripe can barely breathe

definitions.meaning: someone gasping for breath breathes in short quick bursts

explanation.definitionFit: In British slang it means nonsense; as a verb it means gasps for breath.

clue.text: Relative ease at either end in Riviera resort

the word ease has the same letter, E, at either end

explanation.definitionFit: A brother's or sister's daughter is a family relation.

clue.text: Judge excused from joining sacrament, if extreme

parts.note: a junction is a joining point

explanation.definitionFit: Extreme unction, the anointing of the dying, is one of the seven Catholic sacraments.

clue.text: One of 27 to get artist into office

parts.note: to elect is to get into office, and an RA, Royal Academician, is an artist
an RA, a Royal Academician, is an artist; the phrase reads elect an RA

clue.text: Dukakis is tersely taking only part for daughters becoming stars

explanation.definitionFit: The Pleiades were daughters of Atlas who were turned into stars, the Seven Sisters cluster.

clue.text: Weekly occurrence of tourers' and diary's odd things

indicators.note: odd things are the letters in the odd positions of each word

explanation.surface: Something that happens each week, involving oddities from tourers and a diary.
explanation.walkthrough: Take letters 1, 3, 5 and 7 of tourers and 1, 3, 5 of diary's.
explanation.definitionFit: A day of the week comes round every seven days, so it recurs weekly.
